// A package with an import, definitions, optional and required fields.
package p

import "strings"

#Person: {
	name!:  string
	age?:   int & >=0
	email:  =~"^[a-z]+@[a-z]+$" @go(Email)
	...
}
alice: #Person & {name: "alice", age: 30}
a: b: c: 1
let x = 1 + 2
y: [for i in [1, 2, 3] if i > 1 {i * x}]
